title: Assembly Line Workflow Optimizer
description: A manufacturing plant has a sequence of assembly tasks that need to be executed. The tasks are given as a string of uppercase letters, where each letter represents a distinct assembly operation. Certain identical operations require a mandatory cooling time, denoted by an integer N, before they can be performed again. The plant manager wants to find the absolute minimum total time units required to finish all assembly tasks, assuming the machinery can remain idle for specific intervals if required.
constraints: tasks consists of uppercase English letters
input_format: A character array representing tasks and an integer cooling_time.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum total units of time.

examples.explanation: A -> B -> idle -> A -> B -> idle -> A -> B. Total time is 8.
No cooling required: A -> A -> A -> B -> B -> B. Total time is 6.
One valid sequence takes 16 units of time.
